note: CONSTITUTION Art. XIII.4: the declared interaction model of the provider check screen. Screens name what the page shows; controls name what a person can do, where they appear, the one backend call each makes, and where each response leads. enabled_when is a Python boolean expression over the declared state. The words the page shows are the ones below; the tests drive the real handler.

state.cases_loaded: The synthetic cases were read from the local service
state.pending: A check is outstanding; a second one cannot start

loading.label: Loading the cases
loading.message: Loading the cases. If this does not change, reload this page.

ready.label: Pick a case
ready.message: Pick a case, then press Check.

refused.label: Check refused
refused.message: This case could not be checked. Pick a case and press Check again.

MISSING.says: Add what is missing, then check again.

HUMAN_CHECK.says: A person must review this claim.

accessibility.note: Art. XIII.3 (WCAG 2.1 AA): colour-token contrast pairs, checked in the light and the dark palette, and the regions that must stay aria-live. Text pairs need 4.5, control borders 3.
